subject: Request: Senior Pricing Sign-off — Strategic Pilot Discount >20%
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: David Park <david.park@lumimed.com>, Amy Lin <amy.lin@lumimed.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: Senior Pricing Sign-off — Strategic Pilot Discount >20%

Team,

Following this morning's discovery call with LumiMed, they want to move forward with a 6-month pilot of our Hosted API for clinical summarization and notes generation across 10 pilot clinics. Key commercial proposal below: 

- Discount request: 28% off standard Hosted API usage rates for the duration of the 6-month pilot (this is a one-time pilot concession).
- Minimum commit: 250k tokens/month for months 1–2, ramp to ~1.0M tokens/month by month 4 based on acceptance criteria.
- SLA requirements: 99.9% uptime, latency target 95th pct < 450ms; Redwood will provide telemetry access.
- Payment: LumiMed requests net-45 and asks for invoice consolidation at pilot midpoint.
- Legal: LumiMed will execute a short LOI + SOW; they've attached a signed LOI draft for reference.

Why I recommend we consider this: LumiMed is a strategic potential partner in the regional hospital network they operate; if the pilot demonstrates measurable reduction in clinician documentation time, they have expressed intent to convert to an annual committed contract covering +50 clinics. The motion could unlock case studies and a marketplace pathway.

Commercial impact note: A 28% concession materially reduces unit revenue but we expect a higher likelihood of expansion and a strong reference if metrics validate.

Ask: Can I get senior pricing sign-off (VP or CRO level) to offer up to 28% for the pilot? If 28% is too deep, please advise the maximum approved concession and any binding conditions. We need a decision by COB Monday (12/7) to honor LumiMed's timeline.

Attachments: LumiMed_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, proposed_pricing_model.xlsx, LOI_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 15:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior Pricing Sign-off — Strategic Pilot Discount >20%

Thanks Grace — quick clarifying questions before I escalate: 

1) Is the 250k token/month a firm minimum (SOW) or a forecast? If it's a firm commit that helps economics.
2) Do we have estimated monthly ARR if they convert at 50 clinics (ballpark)?
3) Can we tie the concession to a single pilot SOW so the discount automatically sunsets unless they sign a renewal?

Preliminary thought: 28% is on the high side. Our working threshold for senior signoff is >=20%. If we can lock a firm minimum and sunset the pilot discount, I think 24–26% could be defensible to senior leadership for strategic accounts.

I can draft the escalation memo once you confirm the commit mechanics and the projected uplift.

Grace / Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. We are excited to pilot Redwood — the clinicians were impressed with the demo. A few quick points from our side: 

- We can commit to the minimums as stated in the SOW (250k tokens/month to start) and we are prepared to sign an LOI immediately. I've attached the signed LOI for your records.
- Regarding the discount: to keep internal CFO approval moving, would Redwood consider 26% off list instead of 28%? That number keeps the pilot within our cap table approval band.
- Payment: we'd prefer net-45, but can discuss net-30 if that's a hard constraint for Redwood.

If you can confirm commercial terms this week, we can get procurement moving and start the pilot early January.

Best,
David Park
CFO | LumiMed Health
david.park@lumimed.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 20:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Senior Pricing Sign-off — Strategic Pilot Discount >20%

Grace / Ben — approving an exception for this pilot with the following conditions: 

1) Approved discount: 25% off standard Hosted API usage for the 6-month pilot only. This is a one-time, non-precedent-setting concession tied solely to the SOW in attachments.
2) Commit: LumiMed must sign the pilot SOW with a firm 250k tokens/month minimum for months 1–2; if they fail to hit the minimum in either of the first two months, the discount reverts to standard list and Redwood may invoice the shortfall.
3) Performance gates: we require two functional metrics to be met by month 2 — 95th percentile latency <= 450ms and at least a 25% reduction in clinician documentation time in baseline testing.
4) Payment terms: we can accept net-45 for the pilot subject to Legal review and an approved credit check. Legal and Finance will aim to finalize payment terms within seven business days after SOW signature.
5) Expansion path: if LumiMed converts to a multi-region annual commitment covering +50 clinics within 12 months, Deal Desk to re-evaluate a commercial enterprise rate (separate negotiation).

Grace — you have my sign-off for 25%. Ben, please prepare a short formal approval memo (1–2 paragraphs) summarizing the conditions and forward to Legal/Finance so they can prepare SOW and invoice terms. Copy me on the HubSpot deal.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
